lines.beaver: 다음 주 팀 모임 장소는 정하셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Did you decide on the place for next week's team gathering?
lines.beaver_roman: Daeum ju tim moim jangsoneun jeonghasyeosseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I've put together the place details.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Where did we decide to meet?
lines.en: I picked the front of City Hall Station Exit 3.

lines.learner: 많긴 한데 출구 근처에 넓은 광장이 있어요.
lines.en: It is, but there's a wide plaza near the exit.
lines.roman: Mankin hande chulgu geuncheoe neolbeun gwangjangi isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 위치와 방향에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about the location and direction?
lines.beaver_roman: Wichiwa banghyange daehae deo malsseumhae jusigesseoyo?
lines.en: There's a big sculpture on the north side of the plaza.

lines.beaver: 아, 그 조형물 알아요. 그 밑에서 만나요?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, I know that sculpture. Do we meet under it?
lines.beaver_roman: A, geu johyeongmul arayo. Geu miteseo mannayo?
lines.learner: 네, 다 같이 모이기 좋은 곳이에요.
lines.en: Yes, it's a good spot for all of us to meet.
lines.roman: Ne, da gachi moigi joeun gosieyo.

lines.beaver: 벤치 있어요? 저 좀 늦을 수도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Are there benches? I might be a bit late.
lines.beaver_roman: Benchi isseoyo? Jeo jom neujeul sudo isseoyo.
lines.en: There are benches here and there, so I'll sit and wait.

lines.beaver_en: But it's January, so it'll be cold outside.
lines.learner: 밖에 오래 있지 말고 바로 식당으로 가요.
lines.en: Let's not stay outside long and go straight to the restaurant.
lines.roman: Bakke orae itji malgo baro sikdangeuro gayo.

lines.beaver_en: What was the restaurant's name? I'm confused.
lines.en: It's 'Hangangjip.' The name is easy to remember.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Could you post it in the group chat too?
lines.en: Sure, I'll post a map with it too.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. See you next week, then.
lines.learner: 네, 광장 북쪽에서 만나요. 조심히 오세요.
lines.en: Okay, see you on the north side of the plaza. Get there safely.
lines.roman: Ne, gwangjang bukjjogeseo mannayo. Josimi oseyo.
